fonts.use: display: names, page titles, section and card titles

fonts.verified: 2026-09-22 via fonts.googleapis.com css2, latin subset, opsz pinned to 16

fonts.use: one decorative handwritten accent per view; aria-hidden; words also present as text

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: The RSVP panel and the mobile menu sheet: the thing a guest is acting on.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: Sheet edge on the ivory ground; paper, not elevation.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Control feedback: hover, focus, underline, choice state (140–220 ms per the handoff).

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Sheets and drawers, photo-tile lift (240–400 ms).

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: The single initial reveal of an opening: portrait settles, botanicals ease in from the margin (≤600 ms).

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: Default easing: quick start, soft landing, no overshoot or bounce.

motion.name: stagger-step
motion.purpose: Between the hero copy lines on first paint; five steps at most.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Design canvas for phones: dedicated portrait crop, invitation under it, single column.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Two-column editorial strips; weekend becomes two columns.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Full masthead nav; split hero; three-column weekend workspace.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.purpose: The approved images' width; content stops growing here.

ornaments.name: monogram
ornaments.use: Masthead and footer. Original S|T mark; not the CAA logo.

ornaments.name: skyline
ornaments.use: Footer ribbon and the weekend margin: a fine, schematic line drawing. Decorative, not surveyed.

ornaments.name: deco-corner
ornaments.use: Stepped gold corner on the moss band and the journey panel.

ornaments.name: deco-rule
ornaments.use: Under section titles: a short gold rule with a lozenge. Once per heading, never as a divider between every block.

themeContrast.note: Approved by Sara and Tyler; the two earlier proposals remain reachable only by an explicit ?theme= link.
